definition.summary: Sinusoidal embedding of a per-sequence count: no parameters, `width` channels, base `theta`.
definition.description: `steps` delivers one integer per sequence — a count the deployment chooses, such as the number of delay tokens a streaming transcription runs at — and `embedding` is its sinusoidal embedding over `width` channels: `e = [cos(t · f), sin(t · f)]` with `f_i = theta^(−i / (width / 2))` for `i` from 0 to `width / 2 − 1`, the `width / 2` cosines first, then the sines, as Voxtral Realtime's time embedding computes it. Nothing is learned; `theta` is what the weights consuming the embedding were trained against, as a rotary base is, so it is required and has no default. The output stays in the `sequence` domain of `steps`, one vector per sequence, which a conditioning primitive reads across its own domain (`conditioning.scale`).

external_docs.title: transformers: VoxtralRealtimeTimeEmbedding
external_docs.description: The delivery implementation's form: `inv_freq = exp(−ln θ · i / (dim / 2))`, `cat(cos(t · inv_freq), sin(t · inv_freq))`.

width.description: Channels of the embedding: `width / 2` frequencies, each a cosine and a sine.

theta.description: Base of the frequencies: `f_i = theta^(−i / (width / 2))`. Changes the computation, no tensor; required, since the value the weights were trained against is not a default.

steps.description: The count: a rank-zero integer per sequence.

embedding.description: The embedding of the count: `width` channels, cosines then sines, one vector per sequence.

logical_cost.description: The products and the sinusoids over `width` channels, once per sequence; no parameter is consumed.

partitions.description: Each channel pair follows from the count alone: a shard computes the channels it holds.

definition.note: Parameter-free sinusoidal embedding of an integer delivered once per sequence.
